sentences.en: For every disease, illness, or discomfort, there is a drug.
sentences.zh: 每一种疾病、病痛或不适，都有对应的药物。

sentences.en: Drugs that seemingly work miracles and change the world,
sentences.zh: 有的药物看似创造了奇迹，改变了世界；

sentences.en: and drugs that are put in the service of fighting a malady for decades,
sentences.zh: 有的药物被用于对抗某种疾病长达数十年，

sentences.en: only to learn much too late that they have almost no effect at all.
sentences.zh: 结果却在很久之后才发现它们几乎毫无作用。

sentences.en: You could tell the story of the world through the drugs we take
sentences.zh: 你可以通过我们服用的药物

sentences.en: and the diseases they are designed to manage.
sentences.zh: 以及它们旨在治疗的疾病来讲述世界的故事。

sentences.en: This is what the new podcast, Drug Story, is all about.
sentences.zh: 这就是新播客《药物故事》的主题。

sentences.en: On the show, creator and host Thomas Goetz tells the story of the disease business,
sentences.zh: 在节目中，创作者兼主持人托马斯·格茨讲述了疾病产业的故事，

sentences.en: Each episode explores one disease and one drug.
sentences.zh: 每一集探讨一种疾病和一种药物。

sentences.en: Drugs end up being an incredible lens to view our world.
sentences.zh: 药物最终成为了观察我们世界的绝佳视角。

sentences.en: This week, we are featuring an episode of Drug Story,
sentences.zh: 本周，我们将播出《药物故事》的一集，
这是一个独立的纪录片式新闻播客，

sentences.en: the kind of podcast you just don't hear about anymore
sentences.zh: 这种播客你现在已经很少听到了，

sentences.en: and one that deserves your full attention.
sentences.zh: 而且它值得你全神贯注地聆听。

sentences.en: Imagine living with constant itching that never stops
sentences.zh: 想象一下，生活在永无止境的瘙痒中，

sentences.en: not because of age, but because of a simple fly bite.
sentences.zh: 不是因为衰老，而仅仅是因为被苍蝇叮了一口。

sentences.en: That is the reality of Onchocerciasis, also known as river blindness.
sentences.zh: 这就是盘尾丝虫病的现实，也就是所谓的河盲症。

sentences.en: One small tablet of ivermectin, taking once or twice a year,
sentences.zh: 一片小小的伊维菌素药片，每年服用一到两次，

sentences.en: helps stop transmission and protects entire communities.
sentences.zh: 就能帮助阻断传播，保护整个社区。

sentences.en: This is how blindness is prevented.
sentences.zh: 这就是失明如何被预防。

sentences.en: And this is how a generation grows up free from river blindness.
sentences.zh: 这就是一代人如何成长，免受河盲症的困扰。

sentences.en: Imagine that you are a worm, a very specific kind of worm,

sentences.en: Your goal in life, your mission, your only purpose

You need the human body to survive and to thrive.
sentences.zh: 你需要人体来生存和繁衍。

sentences.en: Humans, perhaps understandably, do not care for you.
sentences.zh: 人类，或许可以理解，并不喜欢你。

sentences.en: They curse you and your larvae.

sentences.en: And when they writhe into the eyes, humans go blind.

sentences.en: For centuries, there was nothing humans could do but spite you.
